patch_description: Restructure the solver into a pipeline of modular components: (1) a conflict-graph analysis to compute per-transaction conflict footprints, (2) a multi-start greedy constructor that uses lookahead sampling over full candidate evaluation, and (3) a hybrid local-search refiner combining adjacent-swap, random-swap, and segment-reinsertion moves under a unified time budget. The architecture separates construction from refinement and alternates between them (GRASP-like) so time is spent wherever improvement is found, which yields lower makespans than pure greedy restarts followed by a single hill-climb pass.
